name: retry-on-any-failure-allowlist
title: Parallel-dev robustness: opt-in retryOnAnyFailure allowlist for known load-flake smokes (close B-24c3/B-3d39 deferred findings)
description: Add an opt-in retryOnAnyFailure manifest flag so a small, documented allowlist of known load-sensitive smokes (field-regression-cli, verification-freshness, worktree-repair, review-pass-discard — all verified serial-PASS) also get B-2941's serial pass-2 retry on a FAIL (exit 1), not just on TIMEOUT. Every non-allowlisted smoke keeps the safe default (FAIL is terminal, never retried — so genuine regressions are never masked). Closes the deferred parallel-only-FAIL findings B-24c3:F-001..F-004 + B-3d39:F-001. Stopgap; shared-state root cause deferred. Out of scope: --jobs default, on-disk mutex, main-write-lock, test:coverage.
